Subject: POC Kickoff: Redwood Dedicated trial — next steps

Hi Katie / Tom,

Great meeting today — thanks for the time. Quick recap and agreed next steps so we have everything in one place: 

- Scope: test Redwood Dedicated for embeddings-based search across your clinical docs. Target: 150 qps inference for 512-token inputs; latency target < 60ms p50.
- Success criteria: matching current semantic search relevance on your v1 benchmark + cost projection <= $0.02/query at target throughput.
- POC environment: we'll provision a dedicated pool in us-west-2; you confirmed you have a non-production dataset we can use (anonymized).
- Security: you requested SOC 2 evidence and KMS integration — Rafael is cc'd and will share the SOC 2 pack.

Next steps / owners:
1) I will send the POC plan and onboarding checklist (attached).
2) Your infra lead will share the anonymized dataset + any firewall IP allowlist needed (Tom).
3) Rafael will share SOC 2 and SSO/KMS docs.
4) Kickoff call scheduled: Thu, Jun 18 10:00am PT — invite sent.

If anything above is off, flag it and I'll update. Otherwise I'll follow up after the kickoff with the exact provisioning details and test account.

Attachments: poc-plan.pdf, onboarding-checklist.md

Thanks — excited to get this running.

—
